info.name: WMS API checks
info.description: API checks for the Warehouse Management System. Set adminUsername/adminPassword, integrationUsername/integrationPassword, testUserPassword and baseUrl, then run the collection in order (Collection Runner). Each run creates its own users, product, shelf, containers and pick zone. See qa/README.md and qa/api-tests.md.

item.name: 00 Setup & Auth
